title: YouTube Video Metadata & Chapter Extractor Input
description: Scrape metadata, chapters, heatmap and caption availability for YouTube videos or Shorts.

videoUrls.title: Video URLs or IDs
videoUrls.description: YouTube watch, youtu.be, Shorts, embed or live links, or 11-character video IDs. Duplicates are removed.

maxComments.title: Max comments per video
maxComments.description: Maximum comment texts to collect per video. Set to 0 to skip comments. The display comment count is extracted separately.

includeChapters.title: Extract chapters
includeChapters.description: Extract manual and automatic chapters with title, start, end and source.

includeHeatmap.title: Extract heatmap
includeHeatmap.description: Add the Most replayed heatmap segments and labels when YouTube provides them.

includeEndscreen.title: Extract endscreen
includeEndscreen.description: Extract endscreen elements shown at the end of the video.

includeCards.title: Extract info cards
includeCards.description: Extract interactive info cards embedded in the video.

includeTranscriptMetadata.title: List caption tracks
includeTranscriptMetadata.description: List available caption tracks with language and manual or auto-generated status.

includeTranscript.title: Extract transcript text
includeTranscript.description: Download the transcript when a caption track is available. Adds one request per video.

includeRelatedVideos.title: Max related videos
includeRelatedVideos.description: Number of related videos to extract from the watch page sidebar. 0 skips them.
